knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Forty-five out of fifty is 0.9, which is 90 per cent.
The area score is the average of the room percentages, which gives every room equal weight.
Seventy plus sixty plus sixty-five plus seventy plus ninety plus sixty-five is 420, not the printed 430.
The room score section says elements that are not present in a room are left out of the count.

practicalCriteria: Learner calculates the percentage for a sample room with 37 acceptable points out of 40, with the answer 92.5 per cent given
Learner re-adds a sample set of six room scores and states the correct total, with the total matching the assessor's figure
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed sample calculation signed by the assessor
stopWorkCriteria: A score sheet cannot be re-added and the discrepancy is not resolved
